articles.title: Doctors Modify Hot Glue Gun to Stick Broken Bones Back Together
articles.summary: Scientists in South Korea have modified a glue gun, the kind you'd use for an arts and crafts DIY project at home, to generate bone grafts directly onto fractures in animals. As detailed in a paper published in the journal Device, the team came up with the unusual device to skip the need for prefabricating complex bone implants. In experiments involving rabbits, the researchers created 3D-printed grafts on the fly, allowing fractured bones to heal and regrow naturally.
